args.sql:
SELECT 
    ea.penimp,
    COUNT(*) AS frequency_count
FROM enforcementactions ea
JOIN investigationdetails id ON ea.invdetref = id.invdetreg
JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON id.sentref = sf.sentreg
WHERE sf.infoleaksc > 50.0
    AND sf.corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
    AND sf.eventannotm IN ('Pre-market', 'Intraday')
    AND (0.6 * id.behansc + 0.4 * id.netansc) > 70
GROUP BY ea.penimp
ORDER BY frequency_count DESC;
